session_read: Friday's -3.47% SMH move was a crowded-trade unwind (SMH +75% H1 2026, 82% of managers calling semis the most crowded trade ever) plus record-high CDS on AI-financing names (NVDA/AVGO/AMZN/GOOG/MSFT) -- not a fundamentals break. NVDA and MRVL both beat and still sold off. Drawdown crossed the 8% warn line for the first time this cycle at -8.16%. Real trading happened this week: AVGO was a full stop-out + fresh re-entry (not a trim), and four names (HOOD/META/NOW/TXN) were fully stopped out -- all confirmed stop-loss via email. Stop-loss efficacy jumped to 61.7% win rate (n=155, up from 48.8%), the tight-SL discipline earning its keep this week. Two new WATCH positions (AMKR, IREN) both landed inside the AI-capex chain, now 89.41% of book -- no diversification effect.
